audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 with 50.53% over 380 games fits: Taliyah is a wave-clear and roam mid whose only lane kill setup is Seismic Shove into Unraveled Earth.
Spikes track level 3-5, 6, first item and late; Weaver's Wall at 180/150/120s is a map play rather than a lane answer, which phases[4].why already states.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields call Taliyah "he/his": loading, phases[0].why, breakdown.wave, report[4].t.
audit.why: Taliyah is female. The decisive interaction — Unraveled Earth (flat 14s) only stuns when you dash into it or Seismic Shove knocks you through, so trades exit on foot and Across the Veil stays banked — is already stated correctly in report[5].t and dosFull[0].d.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected; phases[0].why also regrounded on Threaded Volley being a clear tool at level 1.

audit.why: breakdown.cooldowns carries Seismic Shove 14s to 8s, Unraveled Earth flat 14s, Threaded Volley down to 3s at rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.carry is a generic tempo line reusable against any enemy.
audit.why: The specific carry lever here is exiting on foot so her minefield never converts, and stepping up on the 14s Seismic Shove gap.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around walking out and the 14s shove window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Threaded Volley (Q) and Seismic Shove (W) with a grounding flag.
audit.why: Riot's own description for both abilities describes no grounding — the flag almost certainly parsed the words "Worked Ground"/"ground". Per the brief's rule, the description wins, so no grounding claim was written into any field.
audit.corrected: No edit made; recorded here instead.
